time.description: Current world game time in ticks (a wall-clock tick count when the target has no world).

blockType.description: Material name of the previewed block, or the material an entity maps to; empty when neither is present.

customName.description: Player-given name of the previewed container or entity, or empty when unset.

inventory.size.description: Number of slots in the previewed inventory.

inventory.occupied.description: Number of non-empty slots in the previewed inventory.

cookTime.description: Ticks the current smelt has been cooking.

cookTimeTotal.description: Ticks required to finish the current smelt.

burnTime.description: Ticks of fuel remaining in the furnace.

fuelSeconds.description: Fuel remaining in whole seconds (burnTime divided by 20).

bankedXp.description: Total experience banked from recipes used, or -1 on a server without getRecipesUsed.

lit.description: True while the furnace has fuel burning.

surge.active.description: True while a detected speed-up (e.g. a hopper-fed boost) is still within its hold window.

surge.gain.description: Seconds of cook-time progress gained beyond real elapsed time during the last detected surge.

brewTime.description: Ticks remaining until the current brew finishes.

brewTotal.description: Fixed total tick length of a brew (400).

fuelLevel.description: Blaze powder charges remaining in the brewing stand.

surge.active.description: True while a detected speed-up is still within its hold window.

surge.gain.description: Seconds of brew-time progress gained beyond real elapsed time during the last detected surge.

maxBees.description: Maximum bee occupancy of the hive.

honey.description: Current honey level of the hive.

maxHoney.description: Maximum honey level of the hive.

level.description: Current fluid level of the cauldron.

maxLevel.description: Maximum fluid level of the cauldron.

fluid.description: Fluid the cauldron holds: empty, water, lava, or powder_snow.

playing.description: True while a loaded record is playing.

record.description: Readable name of the loaded record, or empty when none is loaded.

lang.description: Resolves a localization key, binding positional arguments onto its placeholder names in order.

count.description: Item count in the given inventory slot, or 0 when empty, out of range, or there is no inventory.

occupied.description: True when the given inventory slot holds a non-empty item stack.

item.description: Material id in the given inventory slot, or empty string when empty, out of range, or there is no inventory.

plain.description: Strips legacy '&' color and format codes from text, leaving everything else untouched.

readable.description: Converts an ENUM_STYLE id into Title Case display text, e.g. IRON_ORE becomes Iron Ore.
